entries.e6f15ea765d175d9: On July 7, 2026, the company announced its medium-term management plan (fiscal years ending May 2026 to May 2028), which sets out the management vision "Enabling everyone to access Honeys anytime, anywhere," and defines the management policies as strengthening existing businesses, deepening new initiatives, and developing the business foundation. Strengthening existing businesses involves expanding store sales (enhancing product and sales capabilities, opening and remodeling stores) and expanding and strengthening the EC business; deepening new initiatives involves expanding Glacial Russo and developing new store formats; and developing the business foundation involves promoting DX, initiatives toward utilizing human resources, and promoting sustainability.
